name: Bulk Price Editor for WooCommerce
author: Mykola Lukin

sections.description:
Increase, decrease, remove, or set new prices in one action for multiple products!

Visit plugin website | Contact us

Changing product prices in WooCommerce takes time, especially for big stores.

Bulk Price Editor makes it easy to update prices for hundreds or thousands of products at once.

Quickly update prices with simple filters and different price change options.

💡 Key features:

✅ Filter Products Easily:

✔️ Categories or Selected Products
✔️ SKU and Product Name
✔️ Stock status
✔️ Product type
✔️ Product Attributes

✅ Multiple Price Changes:

✔️ Increase or decrease prices by percentage
✔️ Set new prices
✔️ Add or subtract fixed amounts
✔️ Remove prices

✅ See Price Changes Before Applying
View original and updated prices to avoid mistakes.

✅ Update Many Products at Once
Change prices for unlimited products, processed in the background for smooth updates.

✅ Simple & Easy to Use
A clear and user-friendly design makes price updates quick and hassle-free.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/bulk-price-editor-for-woocommerce directory, or install the plugin directly through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Enter the WooCommerce -> Bulk Price Editor page to use the plugin
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with variable products?

Yes! Bulk Price Editor allows you to update prices for simple and variable products.

Will this plugin slow down my WooCommerce store?

No. The plugin works with chunks of 100 products, ensuring smooth performance and preventing server overload, even when updating thousands of products at once.

Can I undo price changes?

The plugin does not have an undo feature, but since you can preview price changes before confirming them, you can ensure everything looks right before applying updates.

How many products can I update at once?

There is no limit! Thanks to Action Scheduler, the plugin can process bulk updates for an unlimited number of products efficiently.
